 Jimmy Fallon Gets a Sunday-Night Head Start on Sean Duffy Jokes
 By
 Jed Rosenzweig 
 21 minutes ago 
 A rare Sunday-night Tonight Show gave Jimmy Fallon plenty of fresh material to work with, thanks to the Friday’s nationwide FAA ground stop.
 Airing after Sunday Night Football , Fallon wasted little time getting to the thousands of canceled flights that followed the four-hour-plus ground stop.
 “Jennifer is here for the same reason everyone else is,” he joked of his guest Jennifer Lopez . “Her flight was canceled.”
 Noting that Transportation Secretary Sean Duffy had blamed the outage on aging switches, routers, and copper lines from the 1980s, Fallon quipped, “Apparently our planes are run by the same technology as the Chuck E. Cheese band.”
 But Fallon’s biggest laugh came when he played footage from Duffy’s Saturday press conference, which experienced technical difficulties of its own.
 “Well, I feel better,” Fallon deadpanned after the clip. “Pretty much explains the FAA’s new slogan: ‘What the FAA?!'”
 Fallon later brought out the show’s versions of Duffy and Homeland Security Secretary Markwayne Mullin , who bickered over who was responsible for the ground stop.
 “I really can’t stress enough how out of our depth we are here,” the show’s Duffy finally admitted. “You know, just staggeringly unqualified.”
 Watch Fallon’s full Sunday-night monologue at the top of this post.
